Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings
Sl.
 Date or directions and Court'S Or Judges'S Orders
No
 Registrar's order with
 Signatures
 Wpcrl No. 563 of 2026
 Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Lalit Sharma and Ms. Suraiya Naaz, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Sandeep Sharma, learned A.G.A. with Mr. Vijay Khanduri and Mrs. Rangoli Purohit, learned Brief Holders for the State.

3. By the instant petition the petitioners are praying for quashing of the First Information Report dated 20.03.2026 bearing FIR No. 0105 of 2026 P.S. Rishikesh District Dehradun, wherein, they have been implicated for the offences punishable under sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 r/w section 120-B of IPC.
4.

It is argued by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the impugned FIR has been lodged by a power of attorney holder of the actual owner with the allegations that the name of father of the petitioners were recorded in the municipal corporation by forging certain documents and now after the death since now the name of the petitioners have been entered in the Municipal Corporation they have been implicated.

5. He submits that instead of lodging the impugned FIR the owner of the property should approach to the Municipal Corporation for cancelling their name in the record but instead of that the power of attorney holder lodged this FIR.
6. Apart from this, he submits that the allegations as alleged in the impugned FIR appears to be civil in nature.

7. Issue notice to the private respondent.
8.
Steps be taken within a week.

WPCRL/563/2026 on 2 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48812836/
1

9. Let the respondents may file their counter affidavit within four weeks.
10. Two weeks' time thereafter is granted to the petitioners to file rejoinder affidavit.
11.

For an interim measure, let the investigation pursuant to the impugned FIR may go on, however,
the petitioners shall not be arrested provided they cooperate with the investigation.

12. List this matter on 07.05.2026.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 02.04.2026
